optimizer: Resume A 1000 optimizer and FP32 master weights; learning rate 2e-5
trainable_rule: Original self_attn/cam_encoder including related norms/modulations; B/C also train geometry adapter
selection: Repeat shuffled original A/B/C 2000-group schedule, with unique per-sample noise seeds; sample group reuse across epochs
caption_policy: Reference only; shared existing caption or generate once under per-reference lock; text embedding online per rank, no new full text cache
auto_evaluation: After each 100 updates release training GPUs and evaluate g0 on 64 held-out cases, then resume
activation_checkpointing: block-wise selective: save attention operations; recompute other operations
gradient_sync: Manual 64 MiB buckets after 10 microbatches; not context parallelism
